what: An info bar attached to the bottom of the screen slides down by its own height in .3s ease while scrolling, and comes back up once scrolling has stopped for 1s — a phone bottom bar that steps aside only while moving, regardless of scroll direction

options.wait: Seconds until return after scrolling stops, default 1 — 0 means immediately when it stops
options.after: Not hidden above this scroll position (px), default 0
options.max: Hidden only in windows at or below this width (px) — the original is 650 (phone)
options.--fx-shift: Distance pushed when hiding (via style), default 100% (its own height) — -100% for a bar stuck to the top
options.step: Distance (px) it must move from the last resting position before it hides, default 0 — 80 in the original (hides when the scroll position differs from the previous stop by 80 or more)

use: Today’s date and weather here, one line

from.where: shared.js .bn-info — original .js-sticky-information: on every window scroll adds is-hide and, after clearTimeout, removes it 1000ms later, phone only (650 and below) translate3d(0, 100%, 0), transition transform .3s ease

shared.css .ot-gnav (icon menu bar at the bottom of the screen on phones). Original common.js js-sp-footer-menu: after moving more than 80px it removes -js-show, and re-adds it 500ms after stopping, transform .3s translateY(100%).
